question: Choose the correct meaning of idiom: **Harp on the same string**

options.text: To repeat a single idea endlessly

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Harp on the same string"** means to repeatedly emphasize or dwell on a single idea or topic, often to the point of annoyance. (एक ही बात को बार-बार दोहराना) • **Example:** She kept harping on the same string about the importance of punctuality, even though everyone had already understood it. • The correct meaning of the idiom is: **"To repeat a single idea endlessly."** (बार-बार एक ही विचार को दोहराना) • **Example:** Instead of offering constructive feedback, he just kept harping on the same string about the team's previous mistakes. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To play a strategic game** (रणनीतिक खेल खेलना): Refers to engaging in activities that involve planning and tactics. • **Example:** Chess is a game where players need to play a strategic game to outsmart their opponent. • **Option 2: To be fickle in opinion** (राय में अस्थिर होना): Refers to frequently changing one's opinions or decisions. • **Example:** His fickle opinions made it difficult for the team to make a final decision. • **Option 3: To remain emotionally distant** (भावनात्मक रूप से दूर रहना): Refers to not showing or sharing emotions with others. • **Example:** She remained emotionally distant from her colleagues, preferring to keep her personal life private. 40:T9d3, The correct answer is: **Perfidy**.
